latest_release.name: FreshRSS 1.30.4
latest_release.body:
* [Milestone](https://github.com/FreshRSS/FreshRSS/milestones/1.30.4)

This is a fourth security release in the continuation of [1.30.x](https://github.com/FreshRSS/FreshRSS/releases/tag/1.30.3), mostly to address some severe PHP vulnerabilities and update our official alternative Docker images (Alpine) (our default Docker images based on Debian were already fixed).

Note that our rolling-release channel (*edge*) is recommended for faster security patches.

Bug fixes highlights 🐛:
* PHP CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619 [php#2026-10-21-5](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5)

This release has been made by @Alkarex, @Frenzie and newcomer @icco

Full [changelog](https://github.com/FreshRSS/FreshRSS/blob/1.30.4/CHANGELOG.md):

* Security
	* Docker alternative image (Alpine 3.24) updated with PHP 8.5.12 and Apache 2.4.69 [#9475](https://github.com/FreshRSS/FreshRSS/issues/9475)
	* Docker: disable PHP `session.upload_progress.enabled` for additional security [#9476](https://github.com/FreshRSS/FreshRSS/pull/9476)
* I18n
	* Improve Dutch [#9479](https://github.com/FreshRSS/FreshRSS/pull/9479)
